name: a generic named like a tag stays inside the file that holds it
input:
<message>Adding the hook.</message><todo path="src/hooks/useTodos.ts">Creating the todos state hook</todo><file path="src/hooks/useTodos.ts">import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { Todo } from "../types/todo";

export function useTodos() {
  const [todos, setTodos] = useState<Todo[]>(() => []);
  const byId = new Map<string, Todo>();
  const add = useCallback((title: string): Promise<Todo> => Promise.resolve({ id: "1", title }), []);
  return { todos, add, byId };
}
</file><message>Done.</message>
